name: smwmusic-mega-man-x3-neon-tiger-shining-tigerd
title: Mega Man X3 - Neon Tiger (Shining Tigerd)
description:
I'm on a roll with these MMX3 ports!

This is the Neon Tiger's Theme from Mega Man X3.

Nothing much to say about this one, the variation is a bit lacking and the song itself is kind of meh. I still feel like it deserved a port anyway, so here we are.

Could suit in some sort of industrial jungle or forest. (honestly, no idea where it could fit best)
